environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. Service is exposed internally to other microservices via ClusterIP. No API gateway or request transformation layer. Clients call /api/v1/encrypt directly with arbitrary JSON payloads. The ENCRYPTION_KEY env var is set from a Kubernetes Secret. No rate limiting or request deduplication is configured.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no inspection
config.auth: mTLS between services via Istio sidecar
config.encryption_key_source: k8s secret mounted as env var
